prompts.toaster: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for an original retro desktop screensaver. Create an ORIGINAL turquoise squat angular toaster with a small orange two-blade helicopter propeller mounted on top, dark navy outlines, copper feet and one chunky side lever. Three-quarter FRONT view, front and right side visible; no wings, no eyes, no chrome, no resemblance to After Dark's feather-winged flying toaster. Crisp low-resolution pixel art, chunky square pixels, limited 12-color palette, flat shading, no antialiasing. EXACTLY FOUR animation frames in a perfectly regular 2-column by 2-row grid on a 1024x1024 truly transparent canvas. Each 512x512 cell contains the SAME toaster body at exactly the same center, scale and angle; only the rotor changes position (horizontal, diagonal, vertical, reverse diagonal). Frame art fits within each cell with at least 64px clear margin. Every frame is separate, with no overlap between cells. No background, no drop shadows, no text, no watermarks, no labels, no grid lines. This is new artwork; do NOT use or reconstruct existing screensaver sprites.
prompts.c64: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production sprite for retro screensaver. A charming standalone 1980s breadbox home computer inspired by the general C64 era, wide low brown-beige rounded keyboard enclosure, dark brown chunky keycaps, broad space bar, a small warm amber power light, three decorative turquoise vent slits. Three-quarter FRONT view showing keyboard top and right edge. Crisp chunky low-resolution pixel art with dark navy outlines, flat 12-color shading, coherent with turquoise/copper retro graphics. One isolated object centered on a 1024x1024 truly transparent canvas, fills 75% width and 50% height. Original stylization with modified proportions, NO Commodore logo, NO rainbow badge, NO C64 text, NO other text, NO brands, no monitor, no cables, no wings, no shadow, no background, no watermark.
prompts.amiga: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production sprite for a retro desktop screensaver. An ivory wedge-shaped late-1980s all-in-one keyboard computer inspired by the Amiga era, gray and slate-blue keycaps, two orange function keys, very small coral power lamp, broad low case. Three-quarter FRONT LEFT view with the front keyboard and RIGHT side panel clearly visible. Crucial: include one clearly visible DARK HORIZONTAL FLOPPY DRIVE SLOT in the RIGHT side panel, near the front-right corner; the slot is EMPTY, nothing inserted, no disk present. Crisp low-resolution pixel art with dark navy outlines, flat 12-color shading. One centered object on a 1024x1024 genuinely transparent canvas, fills 75% width and 50% height, comfortable empty margins on all sides. Original stylization with modified proportions. NO Amiga or Commodore logo, no boing ball, no checkered badge, no text, no monitor, no cables, no wings, no shadows, no background, no watermark.
prompts.floppy: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: small original pixel-art floppy disk sprite for a retro screensaver animation. ONE isolated 3.5-inch floppy disk, navy shell, silver metal shutter, cream paper label with two plain turquoise horizontal stripes and NO writing. Slightly isometric three-quarter angle to match inserting horizontally into the right-side floppy drive of a wedge-shaped retro computer. Crisp chunky low-resolution pixel art, dark navy outlines, flat limited-color shading. Centered square-ish disk alone, fills 65% of a 1024x1024 genuinely transparent canvas. No computer, no hands, no labels or letters, no brands, no backdrop, no shadow, no watermark.
prompts.toast: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-art sprite for a playful retro screensaver. ONE isolated chunky slice of golden toast with a gently squared rounded top, thick dark cinnamon crust, honey-yellow crumb and a few small square toasted spots. Three-quarter front view at a jaunty 15 degree tilt. Deliberately graphic and stylized, flat 8-color shading with a dark navy outline, crisp chunky square pixels. No photorealism and no copying of any existing screensaver artwork. Centered on a 1024x1024 genuinely transparent canvas, fills 65% of frame. No wings, no face, no butter, no plate, no text, no background, no drop shadow, no watermark.

followUpEdits.prompt: Edit target: the supplied newly generated breadbox computer sprite. Preserve EVERY other pixel, the computer's geometry, keycaps, turquoise ventilation slits, position, angle, dimensions and truly transparent background. Do not add or remove parts, do not add logos or text, do not crop or rescale the canvas. The indicator should be dark maroon/red, with no yellow or orange glow; the application will light it up red during animation. This is a precise single-detail color edit of the provided sprite, not a redesign.

appIconFrameEdit.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied OWNER'S EXISTING COMPUTER LOGO. Create its framed application-icon variant. Preserve the exact beige vintage computer logo, its green CRT screen and yellow GS lettering, its keyboard and all identifying features; do NOT redesign it or introduce a new computer. Place it centered at 72% canvas width and height on a solid dark blue rounded square tile (#193C4C), inspired by a clean desktop app icon. Tile has 10% corner radius and a comfortable transparent margin of 5% canvas width around its outside. Add one very subtle thin teal-gray inner border (#3D6977). Original logo should retain its retro pixel-art identity but clean up harsh jagged outer silhouette using smooth antialiased edges, no exaggerated blur. Balanced generous padding; no extra text, no symbols, no shadows, no gradients, no gloss, no scenery. 1024 square RGBA with truly transparent corners and outside the rounded tile. This is an owner-requested framing treatment, not a brand redesign.
